### 提交前检查 / Checklist

- [ ] 我确认这是针对本分支（SpacJoy/PCL-CE）的改动，而非官方 PCL CE 的问题。/ I confirm this change targets this fork, not the official PCL CE.
- [ ] 我能解释本次修改的全部内容，包括关键逻辑、异常处理和已知限制。/ I can explain all changes, including key logic, error handling, and known limitations.
- [ ] 我确认未伪造日志、测试结果或其他证据。/ I confirm that no logs, test results, or other evidence have been fabricated.
- [ ] 本次提交不包含无关文件变更、临时文件或构建产物。/ The PR contains no unrelated changes, temporary files, or build artifacts.
- [ ] 提交信息符合 Angular 规范。/ Commit messages follow the Angular convention.
